context_requirements: Functional T-type calcium channels (CACNA1G/H/I) must be expressed and electrically active
A calcium-dependent transcriptional program must be present for blockade to alter gene expression
The cell line must not be dominated by other calcium entry pathways that mask T-type blockade
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across T-type blockers that is absent with inactive analogs
Enrichment of calcium-signaling or CACNA1G/H/I-correlated genes among changed landmark genes
